newsitem.title: POLAND: Prochnik surges on NFI bid to up stake.
newsitem.headline: Prochnik surges on NFI bid to up stake.

text.p: Polish garment maker Prochnik SA jumped 9.3 percent to 10.6 zlotys, after National Investment Fund (NFI) 12 announced a tender for the firm's shares to increase its stake in Prochnik to 32.9 percent, traders said.

The stock did not trade after price fixing due to excess demand. NFI 12, which has 9.9 percent in Prochnik, called a tender on Tuesday to buy 343,501 Prochnik shares at 11 zlotys each. On Wednesday trade in Prochnik shares was suspended.
"Investors believe that the new investor would help the firm and the stock might extend its gains in the next sessions," one trader said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
